annotations.title: Revoke one of your API keys

description: The key stops working at once, on REST and MCP. Only keys on your own account can be revoked. Revoking the key you are calling with is allowed and ends your access, so make a new key first if you need one.
name: revoke_key

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart. The secret is never shown again.

title: Revoke one of your API keys
